entities.name: Ethyl ester saponification
observations: The supplied SELFIES most consistently represent conversion of an ethyl ester, C(=O)OCC, to a carboxylic acid, C(=O)O.
The fused cyclic alkene/ether-containing terminus is retained; no ring opening or alkene oxidation is supported.
The apparent [=N] to O change is likely a SELFIES/parsing artifact rather than an oxime or imine transformation.

entities.name: Aqueous alcoholic hydroxide hydrolysis
observations: Plausible conditions are KOH or NaOH in aqueous ethanol or aqueous methanol, followed by acidic workup.

Matched records specify KOH, chloride counterion, ethanol solvent, approximately 10 °C, with reported yields of 96.1% and 110.1%; the 110.1% value is anomalous and should not be interpreted as literal conversion above 100%.
